Email support ↗
Updated November 13, 2026The native app is in limited testing
How do I install TrustinJr?

The native app is not publicly available yet. Eligible invited adult testers can install or update it through TestFlight. Use the Apple Account that accepted the invitation.

The iPhone or iPad app contains parent controls. The learning activities run on Apple Watch. The current app requires iOS 17 or later and watchOS 10 or later.

For a normally paired adult Watch, install the iPhone beta first, then look for the Watch installation button in the app's TestFlight details. Children's Family Setup Watches need an eligible App Store distribution; uploading a beta does not make that download available. Apple does not permit children under 13 to use TestFlight. Apple's installation instructions.

How does a Watch connect to my child profile?

Once the app is installed through an eligible route, open Watch setup. The Watch displays a six-digit code. In the Parent app, open Family, then Watch setup and Connect Watch. Select the correct child and approve the code shown on that Watch.

The short code expires after five minutes. Request a new one if needed. Once connected, the Watch stays connected until you disconnect or revoke it. Never share pairing codes or passwords by email.

Why does Ask say voice is not ready?

Live voice needs an internet connection and completed provider and parental-permission setup. A pending permission request does not enable it. These release checks are still in progress.

Installed stories and prepared Math can still work without live AI. If an older beta blocks Math as well, update to version 1.0 (60) or later.

What works offline?

Installed storybooks include their narration and play offline. Prepared Math questions and explanations may also be available offline. Starting a new Math session or loading help for the first time can require a connection.

If audio stops, check the Watch volume and connected headphones, then try replay. Tell us the book or activity title and the steps that led to the problem.

My reading-speed change has not reached the Watch.

Confirm the correct child is selected, connect the Watch to the internet, and refresh or enter Story Time. The Parent app shows the setting as applied only after the Watch receives and saves that revision.

How do I manage or delete family information?

The Parent app provides saved-activity controls and export, child management, and Family → Account & privacy. In version 1.0, Delete parent account asks for your current password and confirmation before permanently removing your account and owned family records.

Account deletion ends future online Watch access. Downloaded Watch content and files you exported are not remotely erased. For an access, correction, withdrawal or deletion request you cannot complete in the app, email jrtrustin@gmail.com. We may need to verify that you are the parent before discussing account information.

Read the current privacy commitments and release checks. This support page is not a substitute for the final app privacy notice.

I cannot sign in or reset my password.

Check the account email and connection. Public signup and the complete password-reset flow are still being prepared. If the recovery email does not arrive or the reset link does not work, contact support. Do not send your password, verification code or recovery link.

Tell us what happened.

Email jrtrustin@gmail.com with your app version, iPhone or Watch model, operating-system version, and the steps that led to the problem.

Please leave out children's identifying information, private transcripts, passwords and pairing codes. If a screenshot helps, hide personal information first. We have not announced a public launch date or pricing.
